review_description: Communication from installers was outstanding backup service from Damien and Sales was excellent as well

I initially dealt with Damien over the phone for a quote (and several other companies). Then I followed up by asking Damien to come see the property to ensure the phone/internet quote was accurate. When Damien arrived he checked the property, gave me a lot of information on the system, where everything would be located etc., and then advised he could go with a bigger system and it would be the same price. I jumped on board and the installation was done within the week.The guys were very respectful and enjoyable to deal with, they had a bit of winter weather to deal with and that was worked around no problem. So Good Solar handled the dealings with Western Power/Synergy for me and the system was completed from quote to finalisation within 1 week, with only Western Power to follow up with their end.Highly recommend
